Definition: from G1722 and the base of G2949; swelling inside, i.e. pregnant:--great with child.
BiblicalUsage: Mary travelled to Bethlehem with Joseph to be taxed, being great with child, in Luke 2:5 — the word holds the whole weight of the incarnation in three words.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God entered the world the way we all do, carried by a young mother on a hard road, and that humbleness is the point.
RelatedPeople: Mary, Mother of Jesus; Joseph, Husband of Mary
